findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts:990-997 launches host_run_worker with the inherited environment but does not materialize the submitter's resolved lease session. packages/main/src/cli/ownership-gate.ts:43-47 owner-gates that worker, while packages/main/src/core/owner-session.ts:28-52 derives the fallback identity from process.ppid. For a documented direct-shell, story-bound host_run with no explicit LATTICE_SESSION_ID or host-adapter identity, the submitter and detached worker therefore derive different identities; the worker is rejected as a foreign owner before claiming the run, and submission converges to worker_claim_timeout instead of the durable execution promised by docs/host-run-usage.md:3-7,42-44,234-236. The real cross-host CLI smoke masks this by explicitly injecting LATTICE_SESSION_ID at packages/main/src/tasks/cross-host-review-smoke.ts:371-375. Severity critical: public story-bound managed execution is unusable in fallback-session environments, and an outer takeover cannot authorize the child. Propagate a stable resolved session identity to the authenticated worker or authorize the internal worker through its one-shot capability, then add a real CLI regression with explicit and adapter session variables absent.

readManifest.scanEscalationReason: The story-level diff spans 139 files; candidate-name triage was escalated to the detached-worker ownership path, fallback session derivation, operator contract, and real-CLI fixtures after the source scan exposed an unpropagated execution identity.
